jobAdDetails.title: Unsolicited Applications
jobAdDetails.description:
Unsolicited Applications

We’re always curious to meet talented people who feel a strong connection to Pas Normal Studios and what we stand for.

If you’re passionate about cycling, design, retail, product, marketing, operations, or building strong teams—and you believe your skills could add value to Pas Normal Studios—we’d love to hear from you.

While we may not have an open position that matches your profile right now, we welcome unsolicited applications and keep relevant profiles in mind when new opportunities arise across our global organization.

Please include:

  • A short motivation for why you’d like to work at Pas Normal Studios

  • Your CV (and portfolio, if relevant)

We review applications on an ongoing basis, and will reach out if there’s a potential match.

jobAdDetails.title: Retail Supervisor (Part-time) San Francisco
jobAdDetails.description:
Are you passionate about cycling and appreciate providing excellent customer service in a company with a strong brand and big ambitions? Are you driven by sales and have the desire to create the best Pas Normal Studios Flagship Store? Then please continue reading!

The vision of Pas Normal Studios is to inspire a global cycling movement, embracing the Nordic cycling culture and lifestyle. Creating innovative designs and brand collaborations. Encourage and motivate cyclists around the world through our International Cycling Club.

The physical stores of Pas Normal Studios are a part of our identity. We would like to share the Brand universe and create a community that customers can be a part of. Our shops are a part of a bigger perspective, and we would like to invite our customers a bit closer and allow them to learn about who we are.

On this basis, we are looking for a Sales Assistant to join our team in San Francisco, to deliver the best customer experience in our Pas Normal Studios Flagship in San Francisco.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
The Position: Retail Supervisor (Part-time)

Through your passion for cycling, you will share and create a vibrant atmosphere in the shop with colleagues and customers.


The ideal candidate would be an individual passionate about cycling and fashion, who is able to think outside of the box, and who is willing to assist in all fields in order to help and support the overall team to accomplish all day-to-day tasks in our San Francisco store.


Moreover, the perfect candidate will have extensive knowledge of premium cycling clothing, coffee, and will be a cyclist too.


Furthermore, you will master a strong customer focus and ensure that the Pas Normal Studios vibe is created in communities around the Flagships Store through daily operation and local activations.


  • Ensure the overall look and feel of the store is in line with the brand.
  • Deliver the ultimate experience and customer service
  • Be in charge of shifts and duties within
  • Executing Group Rides
  • Assist in visual merchandising of the shop
  • Assist in maintaining and creating a strong local community
  • Maintain a fully-stocked store
  • Ability to prioritize and demonstrate initiative


You ensure that the Pas Normal Studios vibe is present in and around the flagship store through daily operations and local activations.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Qualifications

The ideal candidate is operating successfully in the retail or café universe and is passionate about driving sales and excellent customer service. You enjoy being a physical presence for one of the strongest and fastest-growing brands in the cycling world.

We are thus looking for an outstanding candidate with a well-assorted and updated toolbox and experience from retail or café business environment.


In addition, you also have:
  • Be specific, be personal, be authentic and lead from the front
  • Fluent in English - other languages are a plus.
  • A passionate and genuine interest in cycling is necessary.
    Personally, you are/have:
  • Good social skills, friendly, helpful, confident, and engaging personality
  • Passionate about delivering excellent customer experience
  • You are highly organized to ensure the smooth running of daily operation in the store
  • You have a keen eye for details and accuracy
  • A structured, motivated self-started capable of driving projects forward engagingly and collaboratively.
  • Highly self-motivated - have energy and a positive mindset with a “can-do” attitude.
  • Flexible and expected to work over weekends

jobAdDetails.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobAdDetails.description:
Purpose
As Strategy & Operations Manager, your purpose is to turn Pas Normal Studios’ strategic priorities into execution that holds. You work alongside the COO across merchandising, commercial and cross-functional projects – structuring the problem, building the case, and staying with it until it runs in the business. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that our strategy and business plan get translated to seasonal execution. The role is based out of our HQ in Copenhagen.

What you’ll do
  • Drive strategic planning and operations across the company, with responsibility for the seasonal go-to-market milestones. 
  • Manage performance reporting and business KPIs: the dashboards and reporting cadence behind our business reviews, covering sell-through, inventory health, margin and progress against plan, so decisions are made on data rather than impressions.
  • In addition, you will work on two or three live projects supporting the Leadership Team on organizational priorities. Examples could be: 
    • Develop business cases for the decisions ahead: a new market or store, a major investment, or a change to how a channel is served.
    • Implement, optimize or re-think a key business process
    • Support strategy development for e.g. channel strategy or product strategy

What you bring
You bring a structured problem-solving toolbox (qualitative and quantitative) and project management skills. Most importantly, you have a demonstrable track record of finishing what you start. The role succeeds based on value implemented; not based on analytical output.
  • A degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance or related field.
  • 3-6 years of experience, typically 2–4 years in management consulting, strategy and operations or business operations, plus a step into industry or a scale-up.
  • The ability to decompose an ambiguous question, build a recommendation, and defend it when it is argued with.
  • Confidence owning a commercial model and working directly in the data: sell-through, rate of sale and margin.
  • Communication that delivers the message clearly to all relevant stakeholders – including the ability to put a complex problem in front of a leadership team in a way that produces a decision rather than a discussion.
  • Interest in AI tools — curious and practical. 
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, creative scale-up environment. An excellent command of English is a must.

What do we offer?
We are driven by our core values of passion, performance, and accountability. Our mission is to challenge ourselves to bring the best possible products to cycling communities globally.
We want work to be fun and inspirational — and to challenge the status quo. We foster an environment with plenty of room to grow and learn as a team and as individuals. You will join a truly international, progressive, and result-oriented team as we continue our ambitious growth journey over the next years.
 
How and when to apply
Please send your CV and cover letter no later than November 11. We will review and react to applications as they are received. All inquiries are treated confidentially.
 
Equal opportunity employer
Pas Normal Studios is an equal opportunity employer and all aspects of employment reflect that. We don’t discriminate based on race, colour, religion, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age, or political orientation no matter where we operate.

About Pas Normal Studios
Pas Normal Studios wants to inspire people to explore their own road. Through innovative designs, brand collaborations and the development and sourcing of products and production methods, we aim to be the pioneering brand for dedicated cyclists. Based in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a global presence and international culture, we are committed to the continuing development of cycling. With inspiration from international art, culture, and fashion, we are a brand defined by contemporary patterns and colors with Scandinavian roots. We are always in pursuit of quality, craftsmanship and sustainable solutions, our products are created for long-term usage, working as a system across seasons.
